title: Squared Euclidean norm as a coordinate sum
statement: For every natural number $k$, every natural number $d$, and every vector $x\in\bbr^d$ with its Euclidean norm, $\norm{x}^2/k=\sum_{j\in\mathrm{Fin}\,d}x_j^2/k$.
replaced:
For every natural number $k$ and every vector $x \in \bbr^d$ with its Euclidean norm,
\[
\frac{\norm{x}^2}{k} = \sum_{j} \frac{x_j^2}{k}.
\]
